behavior: One oldest verified matching inventory entry per discard; recorded bought date before capture date; no last-edited ordering.
Same shared identity policy for Halo photo discards and QuickAck voice/app discard_item; zero-quantity removal uses the same path.
Current voice transcript must authorize removal. Model-selected IDs do not bypass semantic validation.
Uncertain identities, mixed product variants, model errors and no-match results do not authorize a fuzzy fallback.
Frozen photo-job plan and actor/request-scoped voice journal prevent retries selecting a second duplicate, including after household transfer.
Membership checks, full snapshot/revision checks and atomic archive/discard writes protect customer changes.

validation.test_db: Disposable local MySQL 8.4, loopback port 33387; no production writes

limits: Not deployed. Production behavior remains unchanged until release.
Explicit bulk and partial-quantity requests are held for review rather than guessed. This change removes one inventory entry, not an inferred fraction of a multipack.
No customer data was backfilled or restored; no original photo recognition benchmark was performed. Existing photo identification stays in place.
The separate private Thyme V2 tester uses its existing exact-row user approval and canonical revision-protected mutation route; not changed here.
Legacy WRITE_SHARED_ONLY=false removal is disabled rather than retaining unsafe fuzzy deletes.
Model tests are synthetic frozen inventories including the observed incident wording; they are not a claim of perfect accuracy.

release.method: Build guarded overlays onto freshly downloaded serving ZIPs with scripts/discard-identity/build-overlay.py. Abort and rebase if touched source hashes drift.
targets: QuickAck streaming function (resolve exact function from the live stack before release)
preserve: All unrelated ZIP entries, including latest async job-id forwarding, consent adapters, date fixes and voice reliability changes.
Current environment; DISCARD_MATCH_MODEL defaults to gpt-6-astra. No schema migration.
preflight: Re-read current configurations/revisions and all touched serving sources.
Check voice session Dynamo table access supports the discard-actor partition and non-expiring retained request bodies.
Apply overlays with Lambda RevisionId safeguards, preserving independently changed files.
Run isolated canaries with synthetic inventory before any customer mutation; compare actual serving API results.
Keep previous ZIPs and revisions for rollback. Never deploy the full historical checkout.

provenance.shared_context: trepo-company recall returned no relevant discard policy page; no shared memory was written.
